HAPPY HAPPY NEWS!!! 🎉🎉🎉

@Lorna Villaruz, your PIN number came through today and I am crying happy tears at my desk at clinic. Charing, you did it!! After all the papers, the IELTS, the CBT, the waiting waiting waiting... you are now officially a registered nurse in the UK. Thank God!!

Some of you know we trained together in nursing school in Iloilo, and we capped together in 1996. Same hairstyle, same dream. And in our dorm we polished our white shoes every night, and this one always borrowed my polish and never once bought her own 😂 Lorna, you know who you are.

Then she went off to work in Riyadh, then Dubai, almost 18 years out there. When I left for the UK in 2004 she cried at the airport and said "susunod ako, I will follow you." Well, 22 years later she is finally following me!! Haha. I have been telling her to come for 20 years, so you can imagine how I am screaming right now.

Her flight lands in Manchester on 14 January, around 1pm. She is staying with us for the first month in our spare room. I already have the heater on and the thick duvet ready because I know she will freeze. Ben says ok (he really said ok, I was there). Then on 25 January she starts on Ward 7 at Mersey Bank Hospital, induction first, then the preceptorship.

When she was doing her OSCE in Nottingham I sent her a photo of the rain so she knew what she was getting into. Now she is coming to Liverpool anyway, so the rain is her problem now haha. Charing, please bring a proper coat. The Liverpool wind is no joke, and I am not carrying you to the bus stop at 7am in January.

I want everyone to know what Ward 7 is getting: the best nurse I know. Calm, steady, and the patients love her. They are so lucky to have her. I will show her the 14 bus to town on her first Saturday and we will get lost together, I am sure of it.

To all our Filipino family here, please welcome Lorna! You will see her at the Christmas parties, the potluck, the raffle tickets, and next year at Simbang Gabi with us. Our kabayan nurses and midwives always look after each other, so you are not alone here, Charing. Now you have a big family in Liverpool.

Finally, after 22 years of waiting, come home to us, mahal. Welcome to Liverpool!! ❤️✈️
